column1: # What the generated sessions never do (divergences.md, "Known untested").
# A line is listed while its probe (an extended regex, case-sensitive) matches
# none of the generators: csrc/tests/playfuzz/playgen.h, gen.c, ends.c,
# agentgen.c and csrc/tests/rawfuzz/gen.c. When a generator learns the action (and
# names it), the line drops out by itself; a probe of "-" is always listed
# (a gap no word in the generators can show). Directed recordings may cover
# the same ground: this is the random search's blind spot, not the suite's.
gap
typing in the chat or a command (T, /), and chat links
creative mode, or any game mode change
a difficulty change inside a session
weather forced by a dev op (a storm on demand; rain comes only by itself)
a name tag on a mob
a mob spawner staged or sought out
a dispenser or dropper
a sign placed
the options, video settings or controls screens
F2 (screenshot) or F11 (fullscreen)
a generated session as long as a Minecraft day (24,000 ticks): sessions plan 900 to 5,000 ticks; days pass only across chained sessions
two players, or a second client: every start is single-player
